digest.component_or_area: jira data center reconciler harness and acceptance verification
propositions: An issue created in DC must appear in the local store after an inbound pass, and a local edit must appear on the DC issue after an outbound pass, both proven live against a copy of the project's real ticket store with 2600+ tickets

The reconciler must be isolated from this project's production Jira by operating on a separate git repo with no remotes and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, verified as an assertion that fails the job if violated
The copied store must have all .bridge_state* binding artifacts removed to prevent remote writes to production keys, with scrub completeness asserted by glob enumeration rather than a hardcoded list
Multi-page pagination must be exercised by observing the server's effective page size, seeding 2*observed+1 issues in the harness, and asserting all seeded issues are recovered in the inbound fetch

Every bidirectional mutation (create, edit, transition, link, parent, delete) must round-trip individually with a named oracle read from the opposite system, except set_parent's epic case which raises NotImplementedError
A repeated pass after each direction must write nothing, and the inbound assignee path must mint a jira-family identity that persists in the registry across the pass, not merely swallow exceptions
